statements.text:
-- Product image storage assets
--
-- Purpose:
--   Store Sellpia product/option image files in Supabase Storage and keep a
--   code-to-image metadata table for the local HTML review workflow.
--
-- Safety:
--   - This does not change seller data.
--   - This does not change matching decisions.
--   - Browser clients can read image metadata and public objects only.
--   - Uploads should be performed by a local service-role script, never from
--     the browser client.

create schema if not exists asset

create table if not exists asset.sellpia_product_images (
  p_code text primary key,
  own_code text,
  original_file_name text,
  drive_file_id text,
  drive_folder_id text,
  source_image_url text,
  storage_bucket text not null default 'product-images',
  storage_path text,
  storage_public_url text,
  content_type text,
  byte_size bigint,
  upload_status text not null default 'pending',
  upload_error text,
  source_updated_at timestamptz,
  uploaded_at timestamptz,
  created_at timestamptz not null default now(),
  updated_at timestamptz not null default now(),
  raw_payload jsonb not null default '{}'::jsonb,
  constraint ck_sellpia_product_images_upload_status
    check (upload_status in ('pending', 'uploaded', 'failed', 'skipped'))
)

create index if not exists ix_sellpia_product_images_own_code
  on asset.sellpia_product_images(own_code)

create index if not exists ix_sellpia_product_images_drive_file
  on asset.sellpia_product_images(drive_file_id)

create index if not exists ix_sellpia_product_images_upload_status
  on asset.sellpia_product_images(upload_status)
alter table asset.sellpia_product_images enable row level security
drop policy if exists "sellpia product images readable" on asset.sellpia_product_images

create policy "sellpia product images readable"
  on asset.sellpia_product_images
  for select
  to anon, authenticated
  using (true)
grant usage on schema asset to anon, authenticated
grant select on asset.sellpia_product_images to anon, authenticated

create or replace view public.sellpia_product_images_public
with (security_invoker = true)
as
select
  p_code,
  own_code,
  original_file_name,
  drive_file_id,
  source_image_url,
  storage_bucket,
  storage_path,
  storage_public_url,
  content_type,
  byte_size,
  upload_status,
  uploaded_at,
  updated_at
from asset.sellpia_product_images
grant select on public.sellpia_product_images_public to anon, authenticated
drop policy if exists "product images publicly readable" on storage.objects

create policy "product images publicly readable"
  on storage.objects
  for select
  to anon, authenticated
  using (bucket_id = 'product-images')
